title: Trump threatens EU with new tariffs in response to Google fine - Engadget
summary: President Donald Trump announced on Truth Social that his administration is opening a Section 301 investigation into the European Union in response to fines levied on US companies, including a recent €890 million ($1 billion) fine on Google .
